description: Check for new AI coding tools that match the user's saved projects. Use once a day (e.g. at the start of a work session) when the user has a feed key, or when they ask 'anything new for my project?'. Inputs: `key` (uses saved projects and mode, never repeats items, max 3 per day); without a key, optional `since` (date) and `interests` for a one-off look. Returns `new` count and one line per item: name, category, [project it matches], one-line summary, page URL. `{new:0}` means nothing new — say so briefly or stay silent. Has no effect on other tools.

interests.description: interest tags to filter by, for a one-off look without a key

key.description: the user's anonymous feed key from subscribe

since.description: only tools added on or after this date, format YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago)

name: whats_new
title: What's new for you
